body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Quiet watchful black cat with a soft side; sparse observations, room for the fact to land. Voice direction: Soft Canadian male baritone with smooth chest resonance. Intimate conversational stillness, plain measured words and a subtle reassuring warmth. Neither whispered nor sleepy. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
